t: A build-it-yourself two-armed home robot on a rolling IKEA cart.
steps: Choose your path. Build from parts with the free files on GitHub, or buy a developer kit from WowRobo.
For the parts route, order the items on the official parts list. It includes 17 servos, two servo driver boards, cameras, a power station and an IKEA RÅSKOG cart.
Print the plastic parts from the STL files in the XLeRobot repo on a 3D printer.
For the kit route, pick WowRobo's assembled arm package, the base package or the combo. Buy the IKEA cart and the battery separately.
Assemble the robot by following the hardware guide on the XLeRobot docs site. Plan for about four hours.
Install Python and the free LeRobot library on an Ubuntu laptop. Then install the XLeRobot code.
Try the keyboard or Xbox controller teleoperation example to drive the base and move the arms.
Explore the MuJoCo simulation and the training tutorials next.
